# Matt Pocock Skills for this Repository

This repository vendors the promoted skills from [`mattpocock/skills`](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills) `release/v1.1` into `.github/skills/` so GitHub Copilot can discover them as repository-specific skills.

## Included skill groups

- Engineering skills from `skills/engineering/`
- Productivity skills from `skills/productivity/`

## Repository-specific configuration

The imported `setup-matt-pocock-skills` flow is configured for this repository through:

- `docs/agents/issue-tracker.md`
- `docs/agents/triage-labels.md`
- `docs/agents/domain.md`
- `.github/copilot-instructions.md`

## Upstream source and license

These skill files were copied from `mattpocock/skills` and are covered by the MIT license included in `LICENSE.mattpocock-skills`.
